title: FAQs
content:
Everything customers ask before their first order. If yours is not here, message the atelier on WhatsApp — someone who makes the clothes will answer.

Ordering & payment

How do I confirm an order?

A minimum 50% advance confirms your order and starts production. The balance is due before dispatch. International orders are taken at 100% in advance.

Why does the price change with fabric?

Because the cloth is a real part of the cost. Where a piece is offered in more than one fabric, each option carries its own price and the page shows the difference before you choose.

Can I pay in instalments?

The deposit and balance are the two stages. If you need a different arrangement, ask us before you order and we will tell you what is possible.

Making & delivery

How long does a piece take?

Dhanak pieces take 7–8 weeks, Ujala pieces 8–9 weeks. The window on each product page is the one that applies, and it starts when your deposit clears.

Do you ship internationally?

Yes, worldwide and tracked. International orders are paid in full up front. Customs duties and import taxes are the recipient's responsibility.

Can I rush an order?

Sometimes, depending on what is in the atelier that month. Message us with your date before ordering and we will tell you honestly whether we can meet it.

Fit & customisation

What if I am between sizes?

Choose Customized and send your measurements. It costs nothing extra and it is the surest route to a piece that fits. The size guide on each product page shows how we measure.

Can I change the colour or fabric?

Colour, fabric and size can all be customised. Message the atelier before ordering; some changes affect the price and the making time, and we will confirm both before we begin.

Will it look exactly like the photograph?

Very close, not identical. Screens render colour differently and hand embellishment varies slightly between pieces. That variation is a property of handmade clothing.

Returns

Can I return a piece?

There is no refund or exchange for a change of mind, and no exchange on customised orders — each piece is cut for one person. A refund applies where a piece arrives damaged or destroyed. See the Refund Policy.

My piece arrived damaged. What now?

Tell us within 48 hours with photographs of the piece and the packaging, before wearing or washing it. We will repair, remake or refund.

Bridals

Why are bridal prices not shown?

Bridal commissions are priced per piece — the fabric, the weight of handwork and the customisation all move the figure. Start a consultation and we will quote against what you actually want.

How far ahead should I book?

Three months before the date is comfortable. Wedding season fills the atelier early, so the sooner you start the more the design is yours to decide.

title: Privacy Policy
content:
We collect only what an order and a conversation require, and we do not sell it. This page sets out what we hold, why, and how to ask us to change or delete it.

1. What we collect

Information you give us

  • Name, email address and phone number
  • Billing and shipping address
  • Order details, measurements and customisation preferences
  • Anything you send through a contact form, WhatsApp or email

Information collected automatically

  • IP address, browser and device type
  • Pages visited and time spent on the site
  • The site that referred you to us

Information from others

Payment processors, delivery partners and analytics providers pass us the information needed to take payment, ship an order and understand how the site is used.

2. How we use it

  • To make, take payment for and deliver your order
  • To keep you updated on an order in production and answer your questions
  • To improve the site, our products and our service
  • To send occasional news about new collections — only if you opt in
  • To prevent fraud and keep the site secure

3. Who we share it with

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with the people needed to fulfil your order and run the business: payment gateways, shipping partners, IT and analytics providers, and legal authorities where the law requires it. Each is required to handle your data securely.

4. Cookies

We use cookies to keep your cart and preferences between visits and to understand how the site is used. You can disable them in your browser; some parts of the site will stop working properly if you do.

5. Security and retention

We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your information. No transmission over the internet is ever completely secure, so we cannot promise absolute security.

We keep your information only as long as needed to fulfil orders, meet our legal obligations and resolve disputes.

6. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may ask us to:

  • Show you the personal data we hold about you
  • Correct anything inaccurate
  • Delete your data
  • Stop sending you marketing

Email us to exercise any of these. If you are unhappy with our response, you may be able to raise it with your local data protection authority.

7. Other things worth knowing

Public content. Reviews and feedback you post publicly can be seen by others, and we are not responsible for what third parties do with them.

Links elsewhere. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of sites we link to.

Children. Our services are not intended for anyone under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their information.

International transfers. Your information may be processed in countries other than your own, including wherever our service providers operate. We take appropriate measures to keep it protected.

Changes. We may update this policy. Any change is posted here with a new revision date.

Questions about your data? Email saminarasulofficial@gmail.com.

title: Refund Policy
content:
Every piece is made to order for one person. That is the reason for the deposit, and it is also the reason this policy is narrower than a ready-to-wear one.

The short version

  • A minimum 50% advance confirms an order; international orders are taken at 100% in advance.
  • No refund or exchange for a change of mind, or because a piece is not to taste on arrival.
  • No exchange on customised orders — anything cut to your measurements, colour or fabric.
  • A refund applies where a piece arrives damaged, destroyed or burnt.

If a piece arrives damaged

Tell us within 48 hours of delivery, with photographs of the piece and of the outer packaging. Once we have confirmed the damage we will repair, remake or refund the piece — whichever you prefer and the damage allows.

Please do not wear, wash or alter a piece you intend to report. Doing so makes the damage impossible to assess.

Why customised pieces cannot be returned

A customised piece is cut to one set of measurements and cannot be offered to anyone else. The deposit covers cloth and handwork committed the moment production begins, which is why it is not refundable once cutting has started.

If you are between sizes, choose Customized at checkout and send your measurements — it costs nothing extra and it is the surest route to a piece that fits.

Colour and handwork

Screens render colour differently, and hand embellishment varies slightly from piece to piece. Minor variation between the photograph and the piece you receive is a property of handmade clothing, not a defect, and is not grounds for a refund.

To report a damaged delivery, email saminarasulofficial@gmail.com with your order number and photographs.

title: Shipping Policy
content:
Every piece is cut and hand finished to order, so an order is confirmed by deposit rather than by payment in full. This page sets out how that works.

Confirming your order

  • Within Pakistan — a minimum 50% advance confirms the order. Production begins once it is received; the balance is due before dispatch.
  • International orders — payment is taken at 100% in advance.

Making time

Dhanak pieces take 7–8 weeks. Ujala pieces take 8–9 weeks. The window shown on each product page is the one that applies to that piece, and it starts from the day the deposit clears — not from the day the order is placed.

Customisation to colour, fabric or measurements may extend that window. We will tell you before we begin if it does.

Dispatch and delivery

Orders are dispatched once the balance is settled and the piece has passed final finishing. You will receive tracking details at dispatch.

Delivery timelines after dispatch depend on the courier and destination. Customs duties, import taxes and clearance charges on international orders are the responsibility of the recipient.

Address accuracy

Please check your shipping address before confirming. We are not able to redirect a parcel once it has been handed to the courier, and re-delivery to a corrected address is charged at cost.

Questions about an order in production? Email saminarasulofficial@gmail.com or message the atelier on WhatsApp.
